scope: Independently decomp all 14 SendLogReceiver body parsers (BCS-Y-0956..0969) to confirm or refute the sendlogreceiver-demux pass's inferred byte+0x10 per-parser writes. Promote BCS-Y-0956 confidence probable -> confirmed once independent decomp evidence exists (had demoted; the closure provides the evidence).

method.step1: Ghidra DumpFunctionDecomp on all 14 parsers (BCS-Y-0956..0969 VAs in 0x008A0AE0..0x008A2660). Log: tools/ghidra/logs/e_body_parsers_decomp.txt (781 lines).
method.step2: Scan each parser's body for memory writes. Categorize by output arg pattern (4-arg vs 5-arg) and by per-shape payload pattern (none / variable byte memcpy / 16B fixed / 32B fixed / 64B fixed).
method.step3: Cross-correlate with existing BCS-Y-0956 signature note `(packet+0x10, &this[5], &this[6], (byte*)this+0x1a)`: params 2/3/4 map to receiver fields at this+0x14/0x18/0x1a. None of the params is this+0x10.
method.step4: Per-parser notes append with refutation evidence + shape classification. BCS-Y-0956 confidence promote probable -> confirmed.

key_findings: **The sendlogreceiver-demux pass byte+0x10 hypothesis REFUTED.** None of the 14 parsers write to byte+0x10 of any argument. The sendlogreceiver_demux.json inference about per-parser byte+0x10 writes was incorrect.

**The sendlogreceiver-demux pass's 4-shape-family hypothesis was off by one - actual factorization is 5 payload-write patterns x 4 sender-type families = 20 opcodes** covering the SendLog range 0x157..0x16A. Clean 5x4 factorization (rather than 4x5 or other partition).

**Common shape across all 14 parsers**: reads source header (offset +4 dword, +8 u16, +0xA byte) and writes those values via params 2/3/4 to receiver fields at this+0x14/0x18/0x1a respectively. The 4-arg parsers (Shape A: BCS-Y-0956/0961) do only this; the 12 5-arg parsers add a per-shape payload write via param_5 (which is a vector container: *(param_5+4) is the data pointer, FUN_006D5AF0 is the capacity-grow helper, FUN_009D22B4 is a bounds-check assertion).

**The actual discriminator is the FUN_006D5AF0 capacity argument**: 0x10 for Shape C (16B), 0x20 for Shape D (32B), 0x40 for Shape E (64B), and a runtime byte-read from the source header for Shape B (variable byte memcpy). Not a byte+0x10 sentinel; the shape is statically baked into each parser as a constant arg.

**BCS-Y-0956 confidence promoted probable -> confirmed**. An earlier hygiene pass had demoted it because of the explicit 'NOT independently decompiled in the sendlogreceiver-demux pass' note. the independent decomp resolves that condition.
deferred_followups: The sendlogreceiver-demux pass originally hypothesized 4 shapes based on sender-type-family suffix (1/2 for With/WithoutActor, etc.); the actual 5 shapes are determined by payload size. Naming correspondence is a low-EV cleanup if any future opcode work needs structural attribution.

Verify the FUN_006D5AF0 (vector-grow helper) signature and FUN_009D22B4 (bounds assertion) - the std::vector-like growth pattern across 12 parsers suggests these are standard MSVC STL helpers; could be cataloged for future C++ STL pattern recognition. Low-EV.
